sources_inspected.label: Brazos CAD Property Search (accessed 2026-08-26)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official Brazos CAD Property Search supplies owner-name, abstract, property-ID, property-type, owner-ID, geographic-ID, tax-year, and other source-displayed search modes; its current property-type list includes Mineral.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: Its current disclaimer labels displayed 2026 values preliminary and the information research-only, and warns that legal descriptions and acreage should be verified before legal use. The article preserves these limits and does not infer identity, ownership, title, acreage, appraisal correctness, tax, value, or legal effect.

sources_inspected.label: Brazos CAD Property Search, Help and FAQs (accessed 2026-08-26)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current official Brazos CAD help page says online records are not official and can change, describes current name, address, advanced-search, narrowing, Property ID, and result-saving behavior, and states that mineral properties are not shown on its map because of missing map data.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: It supports interface and negative-result limitations only. The article does not use the map as negative proof, download or email a result, contact the district, submit a request, challenge an appraisal, or retrieve a valuation.

sources_inspected.label: Brazos County, Property Taxes (accessed 2026-08-26)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current Brazos County page states that the tax assessor-collector provides consolidated assessment and collection services and routes specific property-tax account information to the Brazos County Tax Office.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: It supports the distinction between an appraisal-district search and county tax-account service only. The article does not retrieve a tax bill, state a tax amount, interpret liability, or contact the tax office.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller, Local Property Appraisal and Tax Information (accessed 2026-08-26)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas Comptroller county directory supplies the official statewide route to local appraisal districts and tax assessor-collectors and states the local-information boundary.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: It supports jurisdiction and routing context only. This article does not repeat the statewide directory worksheet or claim that a local result is complete, current, accurate, or legally sufficient.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Tax Code Chapter 25, Local Appraisal (accessed 2026-08-26)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Tax Code Chapter 25 supplies statutory context for appraisal records and appraisal-roll contents.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: It does not make the website result a title record, prove current ownership or acreage, validate a legal description, certify an appraisal, establish tax liability or mineral value, connect a property to a well or payment, or support an offer or transaction conclusion.
